org: misaelsalazar980
service: tallerusuarios
frameworkVersion: "4"

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs22.x
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'local'}
  region: us-east-1
  environment:
    STAGE: ${self:provider.stage}
    USERS_TABLE: taller-${self:provider.stage}-users
    JWT_SECRET: ${ssm:/taller/${self:provider.stage}/jwt-secret}
    CORS_ORIGINS: ${file(./config/config-${self:provider.stage}.json):CORS_ORIGINS}
  apiGateway:
    restApiId:
      Fn::ImportValue: MainRestApiId
    restApiRootResourceId:
      Fn::ImportValue: MainRestApiRootResourceId
  iamRoleStatements:
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - dynamodb:PutItem
        - dynamodb:GetItem
        - dynamodb:UpdateItem
        - dynamodb:DeleteItem
        - dynamodb:Query
        - dynamodb:Scan
      Resource:
        - Fn::GetAtt: [UsersTable, Arn]
        - Fn::Join:
            - "/"
            - - { Fn::GetAtt: [UsersTable, Arn] }
              - "index/*"

plugins:
  - serverless-localstack

custom:
  localstack:
    stages:
      - local
    host: http://localhost
    edgePort: 4566
    autostart: false

functions:
  register:
    handler: src/handlers/register.handler
    name: taller-${self:provider.stage}-Users-Register
    events:
      - http:
          method: post
          path: /users/register
          cors:
            origin: "*"
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Date
              - X-Amz-Security-Token

  login:
    handler: src/handlers/login.handler
    name: taller-${self:provider.stage}-Users-Login
    events:
      - http:
          method: post
          path: /users/login
          cors:
            origin: "*"
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Date
              - X-Amz-Security-Token

  getUser:
    handler: src/handlers/getUser.handler
    name: taller-${self:provider.stage}-Users-GetUser
    events:
      - http:
          method: get
          path: /users/{userId}
          authorizer:
            type: TOKEN
            authorizerId:
              Fn::ImportValue: MainAuthorizerId
          cors:
            origin: "*"
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Date
              - X-Amz-Security-Token

  updateUser:
    handler: src/handlers/updateUser.handler
    name: taller-${self:provider.stage}-Users-Update
    events:
      - http:
          method: put
          path: /users/{userId}
          authorizer:
            type: TOKEN
            authorizerId:
              Fn::ImportValue: MainAuthorizerId
          cors:
            origin: "*"
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Date
              - X-Amz-Security-Token

  deleteUser:
    handler: src/handlers/deleteUser.handler
    name: taller-${self:provider.stage}-Users-Delete
    events:
      - http:
          method: delete
          path: /users/{userId}
          authorizer:
            type: TOKEN
            authorizerId:
              Fn::ImportValue: MainAuthorizerId
          cors:
            origin: "*"
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Date
              - X-Amz-Security-Token

resources:
  Resources:
    UsersTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.USERS_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: userId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: email
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: userId
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: EmailIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: email
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
